name: Teedy CI流水线
on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 配置Java17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: temurin
          cache: maven
      - name: PMD代码质量扫描
        run: mvn pmd:pmd
      - name: Maven编译打包
        run: mvn clean package -DskipTests
      - name: 运行单元测试
        run: mvn test
      - name: 生成JavaDoc接口文档
        run: mvn javadoc:javadoc jar:jar
      - name: 保存构建Jar包
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Teedy构建产物
          path: target/*.jar
